# PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the installer generation pipeline — every
          # sh artifact under site/ and the generator that renders them.
          # Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke (pull_request
          # + validation dispatch); the classifier failure arm above runs
          # it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^site/|^scripts/gen_installers\.dart$)'; then
            echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1659: the office add-in acceptance suite — the exact path
          # list the retired standalone office-addin.yml push/PR triggers
          # carried. Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke
          # (pull_request + validation dispatch); the classifier failure
          # arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^office_addin/|^flutter_app/|^packages/|^lib/|^pubspec\.lock$|^scripts/build_office_addin\.sh$|^\.github/workflows/office-addin\.yml$)'; then
            echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
            # Dispatch done — the stages classifier below reads a
            # pull_request event's base/head only; on dispatches the group
            # outputs stay with the non-PR filter step (full gate).
            exit 0
          fi
          stages=$(scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run |
            sed -n 's/^Fast gate scope: .*stages://p')
          echo "gate stages:[$stages]"
          # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.
          [ -z "$(echo $stages)" ] && stages="size analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"
          case " $stages " in *"flutter"*) echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          case " $stages " in *"test-core"*) echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          case " $stages " in *"analyze"*) echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          # Issue #551: test/integration changes select the mock-LLM leg.
          case " $stages " in *"integration-mock"*) echo "intmock=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          # All nine stages selected = a shared/unknown path changed:
          if [ -z "$(echo $stages)" ]; then
            # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.
            stages="size analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"
          fi
          if [ "$(echo $stages | wc -w)" -eq 9 ]; then
            echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #303: the #262 DoD perf gate must red-block the MERGE for
          # trajectory regressions, not only the release — before #551 the
          # only integration leg outside PRs was tag-time. The perf-gate
          # leg re-selects the same gate via --tags perf. Paths = everything
          # the #262 fix touched: ledger core, fa_ui trajectory widgets, CLI
          # trajectory parts, the fah entrypoint, its tests, and the app's
          # session load path.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^lib/src/trajectory/|^packages/fa_ui/lib/src/trajectory/|^lib/src/cli/trajectory_|^bin/fah\.dart$|^test/(integration/)?trajectory/|^flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service(_sessions)?\.dart$)'; then
            echo "perf=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1241 REG-1: the usage fold consumes the trajectory ledger's
          # model_request_summary records and the session chain's shape —
          # a red usage-fold suite blocks the merge even when the regular
          # legs are green.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^lib/src/trajectory/|^lib/src/session/|^lib/src/usage/|^test/usage/|^lib/src/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger\.dart$)'; then
            echo "usagefold=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #709: live kernel-mode cube legs. The ubuntu test-core shards can
  # only prove the SBPL PROFILE TEXT (unit + guard/profile parity) — the
  # kernel's last-match-wins read/write enforcement of rw mounts under a

        with:

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset

          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2) — lockfile-modified release smoke. Resolution
  # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible on every resolve, and the
  # breaking arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview nobody
  # declares) lands as a flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff — a surface the PR

  # lockfile, #726 retry, skew fail-fast — test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_
  # test.dart), so a pubspec/lockfile skew fails HERE loudly before any
  # build step. Path-triggered like exzone: pull_request events AND SM

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-lock-smoke:

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}

          channel: stable

      - name: Install Linux desktop toolchain

      - name: flutter build ${{ matrix.os }} --release (lockfile smoke)

quality-gate:
    name: Quality gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes, static, flutter-analyze, test-core, coverage-gate, guards, flutter-tests, app-crap-gate, test-faui, perf-gate, usage-fold, cli-visual-settings, cube-kernel-live, build-web, build-android, build-ios, build-macos, integration-mock, hostile-env, fa-aot-build, pty-integration-linux, pty-coverage-gate, pty-visual, supply-chain, dep-audit, installer-portability, installer-verify, install-pin-gate, flutter-app-exzone, flutter-app-lock-smoke, office-addin-suite]
    if: always() && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    # #1368: the publish job consumes dart_ok — the pure-Dart package verdict
    # — instead of this aggregate's result. The aggregate itself stays the
    # single required check: any red leg (platform included) still fails it.
    outputs:
      dart_ok: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.dart_ok }}
    steps:
      - name: Report leg results
        run: |
          echo "static        = ${{ needs.static.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "test-core     = ${{ needs.test-core.result }}"
          echo "coverage-gate = ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "guards        = ${{ needs.guards.result }}"
          echo "flutter-analyze = ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}"
          echo "flutter-tests = ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}"
          echo "test-faui     = ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}"
          echo "app-crap-gate = ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}"
          echo "perf-gate     = ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}"
          echo "usage-fold    = ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}"
          echo "cube-live     = ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}"
          echo "cli-visual    = ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}"
          echo "build-web     = ${{ needs.build-web.result }}"
          echo "build-android = ${{ needs.build-android.result }}"
          echo "build-ios     = ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}"
          echo "build-macos   = ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}"
          echo "integ-mock    = ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "pty-integ-linux = ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}"
          echo "fa-aot-build  = ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}"
          echo "pty-gates     = ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "pty-visual    = ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}"
          echo "supply-chain  = ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}"
          echo "dep-audit     = ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}"
          echo "installer-it = ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}"
          echo "installer-reg  = ${{ needs.installer-portability.result }}"
          echo "pin-gate    = ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}"
          echo "exzone      = ${{ needs.flutter-app-exzone.result }}"
          echo "lock-smoke  = ${{ needs.flutter-app-lock-smoke.result }}"
          echo "office-addin  = ${{ needs.office-addin-suite.result }}"
      - name: Fail on any real failure (skipped security = dodge = FAIL)
        id: gate
        env:
          R_CHANGES: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          R_SUPPLY_CHAIN: ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}
          R_DEP_AUDIT: ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}
          R_STATIC: ${{ needs.static.result }}
          R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE: ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}
          R_TEST_CORE: ${{ needs.test-core.result }}
          R_COVERAGE: ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}
          R_GUARDS: ${{ needs.guards.result }}
          R_FLUTTER: ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}
          R_CRAP: ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}
          R_FAUI: ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}
          R_PERF: ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}
          R_USAGE_FOLD: ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}
          R_CUBE: ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}
          R_CLI_VISUAL: ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}
          R_BUILD_WEB: ${{ needs.build-web.result }}
          R_BUILD_ANDROID: ${{ needs.build-android.result }}
          R_BUILD_IOS: ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}
          R_BUILD_MACOS: ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}
          R_INTEG: ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}
          R_HOSTILE: ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}
          R_PTY_LINUX: ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}
          R_FA_AOT: ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}
          R_PTY_GATES: ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}
          R_PTY_VISUAL: ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_VERIFY: ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_REG: ${{ needs.installer-portability.result }}
          R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE: ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}
          R_EXZONE: ${{ needs.flutter-app-exzone.result }}
          R_LOCK_SMOKE: ${{ needs.flutter-app-lock-smoke.result }}
          R_OFFICE_ADDIN: ${{ needs.office-addin-suite.result }}
        run: |
          fail() { echo "Quality gate FAILED: $1"; exit 1; }
          # Verdict pass collects blockers WITHOUT exiting, so dart_ok is
          # always exported explicitly ('true' or 'false', never '') —
          # publish and the Provider smoke read this output and an empty
          # value must never read as either (review thread on #1370).
          dart_blocker=""
          # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
          # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
          # through with zero gates executed.
          [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
          # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
          # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
          # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
          if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
            [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
          fi
          if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
            [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
          fi
          # #1368 — two independent verdicts over the needs legs:
          #   PACKAGE legs (everything NOT platform) → dart_blocker: they
          #     gate dart_ok AND the aggregate — analyze/test/coverage must
          #     gate the publish (review thread: the case bodies were
          #     swapped in the first cut, re-enshrining the starvation);
          #   PLATFORM/NATIVE/PTY legs (build-web/android/ios/macos,
          #     fa-aot-build, installer-verify, install-pin-gate,
          #     cube-kernel-live, cli-visual-settings, pty-*) → platform_red
          #     only: they redden the required aggregate but NEVER dart_ok —
          #     a red Windows build must not hold the pure-Dart publish
          #     hostage (the v1.0.519-521 starvation).
          platform_red=false
          for kv in "static:$R_STATIC" "flutter-analyze:$R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE" "test-core:$R_TEST_CORE" "coverage-gate:$R_COVERAGE" \
                    "guards:$R_GUARDS" "flutter-tests:$R_FLUTTER" "app-crap-gate:$R_CRAP" \
                    "test-faui:$R_FAUI" "perf-gate:$R_PERF" "usage-fold:$R_USAGE_FOLD" "cube-kernel-live:$R_CUBE" \
                    "cli-visual-settings:$R_CLI_VISUAL" "build-web:$R_BUILD_WEB" \
                    "build-android:$R_BUILD_ANDROID" "build-ios:$R_BUILD_IOS" "build-macos:$R_BUILD_MACOS" \
                    "integration-mock:$R_INTEG" "hostile-env:$R_HOSTILE" \
                    "fa-aot-build:$R_FA_AOT" \
                    "pty-integration-linux:$R_PTY_LINUX" "pty-coverage-gate:$R_PTY_GATES" "pty-visual:$R_PTY_VISUAL" \
                    "installer-portability:$R_INSTALLER_REG" \
                    "installer-verify:$R_INSTALLER_VERIFY" "install-pin-gate:$R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE" \
                    "flutter-app-exzone:$R_EXZONE" "flutter-app-lock-smoke:$R_LOCK_SMOKE" "office-addin-suite:$R_OFFICE_ADDIN"; do
            name="${kv%%:*}"; r="${kv#*:}"
  …

        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true

          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/pr-dry-run-stage
          # gh-1538: the STAMP rehearsal moved here from the retired nightly
          # full-quality leg — the pre-merge gate is the single test gate
          # now, so a stamp failure (placeholder leak, changelog-section
          # generation, staged-version desync, cap trim) must redden the
          # PR, not surface at tag time. Rehearses the NEXT tag's payload
          # exactly like the nightly leg did (gh-1522).
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the stamp of the NEXT tag: v$next"

# Runner split (gh-1005, 2026-09-30): pure-Dart AND all PTY/terminal jobs ->
# ubuntu-24.04-arm (public repo: free, SEPARATE capacity pool from the x64
# queue). Flutter-test legs on arm64 bootstrap the SDK via git clone — Flutter
# ships NO official linux-arm64 SDK (stable manifest is x64 only;
# subosito/flutter-action fails 'version: any architecture: arm64'); x64
# Flutter jobs keep the action. The self-hosted M5 pool is ONE runner
# (fa-m5-1, user LaunchAgent) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work:
# cube-kernel-live. PR PTY legs (integration shards, coverage/duration gates,
# Terminal visual) run hosted-Linux only and never wait on fa-m5-1.
name: CI

on:
  push:
    # gh-1537: NO `branches: [main]` here — the post-merge main CI run is
    # retired. The SM's pre-merge validation dispatch (machine-sm.yml ->
    # factory-sm, strictly serialized) validates the exact tree that
    # merges, so a main-push run would be pure repetition; retiring it
    # kills the duplicate wall time AND the release-bot-commit churn that
    # retriggered it (#1522 lands the tag-sourced versions). The v* tag
    # push stays: the release pipeline (publish/binaries) keys on it, and
    # the full quality gate runs on the tag BEFORE anything publishes.
    tags: ['v*']
  # Dispatch-only CI on PR heads (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes
  # fire NO CI — the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger.
  # It dispatches this workflow on the PR head when validation is due
  # (validate-fresh / validate-armed rules), so intermediate dev/rework
  # pushes and silent branch updates are free. Required checks still
  # match: the dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      releaseDryRun:
        description: 'gh-1172: run the release pipeline without the push/tag (logs the commit+tag that WOULD land)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      releaseDispatch:
        description: 'gh-1172: real release (cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release directly, gh-1522) on manual dispatch — requires refs/heads/main; bare validation dispatches stay inert'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  # Any release publication (API `gh release create`, web UI, or a pushed
  # annotated tag) builds + attaches the binaries matrix. Pushed tags also
  # arrive via the push filter above; the quality gate is NOT re-run by
  # the release twin — the release-dedupe pre-check (gh-1625) short-circuits
  # every gate leg when the tag's GREEN push run already gates it, while
  # the release-specific legs (binaries attach, release-provenance,

Folded the Office add-in acceptance suite into `ci.yml` as a path-gated `office-addin-suite` job and retired `office-addin.yml`'s `push`/`pull_request` triggers — a PR now gets ONE workflow entry. The dispatch-only daily-publish leg still fires `office-addin.yml` directly.

- Job body byte-identical to the daily leg's (drift-guard test pins the two copies) — no behavior change; runner/timeout (`ubuntu-latest`, 45m, `contents: read`) unchanged.
- Wired into `quality-gate` as a PLATFORM-class leg (#1368): a red suite blocks the merge via the aggregate but never holds the pure-Dart publish; non-touching PRs skip exactly as today.
- **Check name for the ruleset update (AC3):** the check-run name is unchanged — `Office add-in suite` (branch protection / ruleset contexts that match the bare job name keep working). flowchart TD

# gh-1659: [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)

## Description

## [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (stop the per-PR standalone workflow)

### Product frame

Every PR touching `lib/**`, `packages/**`, `flutter_app/**` (most PRs) currently triggers a SECOND, standalone workflow — "Office add-in" (`office-addin.yml`, e.g. run 38965610602 on `feat/1646-antistop`). The PR page shows two CI entries per push; the check runs outside the ci.yml matrix and its name has to be tracked separately in branch protection. It should be one job inside the common `ci.yml` matrix, path-gated the same way the other jobs are.

### Evidence

- `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml` — `on: push/pull_request: branches:[main]` with paths `office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`.
- ci.yml already has the canonical pattern: a `changes` job (outputs per-path filters) + jobs gated on `needs.changes.outputs.<filter> == 'true'` (see `Core tests` at line ~789 and its `if:` at ~878).

### Required capabilities

- **C1 — job moves into ci.yml.** The `office-addin-suite` job (build + suite from `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`) becomes a ci.yml job gated on a new `changes` output (e.g. `office_addin` — same path list as today). No behavior change to what the job runs.
- **C2 — standalone PR/push triggers go away.** `office-addin.yml` keeps ONLY the `workflow_dispatch` entry (the daily-publish addin leg — `pages.yml` and the daily-publish flow depend on it; its dispatch group must stay intact). The `push`/`pull_request` blocks are deleted so a PR never spawns the separate workflow again.
- **C3 — branch protection stays coherent.** If the ruleset requires today's check name "Office add-in / office-addin-suite", either the moved job keeps a matching `name:` or the ruleset is updated to the new "CI / …" name — the owner applies ruleset changes; the PR must document the exact new check name in its description.
- **C4 — no path-skip regression.** PRs touching none of the office-addin paths must NOT run the job (same skip as today); the ci.yml always-runs pattern (line ~789 comment) must not be violated — skipped-vs-passed reporting stays correct for the ruleset.

### Test matrix

- actionlint / workflow lint in CI (existing gates).
- Manual: open/see a PR touching only `lib/**` — exactly ONE workflow (CI) runs, with the office-addin job inside; a PR touching only `docs/**` skips it.
- Dispatch the daily leg (`workflow_dispatch`) — still works from `office-addin.yml`.

### Platform inventory

- `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml` (remove push/pull_request triggers).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (changes job output + new job).
- No Dart changes.

### Security

No new secrets or permissions; the job keeps its current `contents: read`.

### Acceptance

- [ ] AC1: a `lib/**`-only PR runs the office-addin suite inside ci.yml (one workflow entry per push).
- [ ] AC2: `office-addin.yml` no longer fires on push/pull_request; the daily dispatch leg still works.
- [ ] AC3: the new check name is documented for the owner's ruleset update.
- [ ] AC4: non-touching PRs skip the job exactly as today.

# Office add-in (Outlook taskpane) acceptance suite (issues #89, #182):
# the taskpane IS the fa Flutter web app (outlook/app/) — validates the
# manifest, builds the app bundle with the office host flag, runs the
# office package Dart unit tests, the app's office wiring tests, and
# Playwright (chromium + webkit) against the assembled pane pages.
#
# gh-1659: this workflow is the DISPATCH-ONLY daily leg now. The PR/push
# gate moved into ci.yml (job `office-addin-suite`, path-gated on the
# classifier's `office_addin` output — same path list the retired
# push/pull_request triggers carried), so a PR gets ONE workflow entry
# instead of two. daily-publish.yml still dispatches THIS workflow for
# the addin leg and watches its office-addin-suite job (#343/#344), and
# the two job bodies are pinned step-identical by
# test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart — update both together.
name: Office add-in

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177) — but a
# workflow_dispatch run (the daily-publish addin leg) gets its OWN group:
# a push landing mid-daily used to cancel the leg's run, failing the leg
# as "higher priority waiting request exists" and self-filing a false
# release issue (issue #423).
concurrency:
  group: Office add-in-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && format('dispatch-{0}', github.run_id) || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# SEC-08 (#796): explicit minimal permissions (artifact uploads only).
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  office-addin-suite:
    name: Office add-in suite
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily addin watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # dart + chrome-platform tests + add-in build + Playwright
    # chromium/webkit install & e2e; historically ~20m.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 22

      # office_addin/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root),
      # so its pub get must follow the root's.
      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      - name: Dart unit tests (office_addin/dart)
        run: cd office_addin/dart && dart pub get && dart test

      # The app build needs the gitignored placeholders (.env asset and
      # firebase_options.dart) — same dance pages.yml does.
      - name: App placeholders (.env + firebase_options)
        run: |
          touch [REDACTED:Credential File]
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 2): resolve flutter_app through the
      # shared retry action BEFORE the first flutter consumer — the package
      # config doesn't exist at checkout, so "Chrome boot tests" would
      # otherwise trigger flutter test's implicit (unenforced, unretried)
      # pub get first.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The office boot seam compiles web-only code, so its guard tests run
      # on the chrome platform (VM suite can't import them). FA_HOST=office
      # compiles the real boot branch in; Office.js is absent in the test
      # browser, pinning the clean office_unavailable failure path.
      - name: Chrome boot tests (flutter_app/test/web)
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/web --platform chrome --dart-define=FA_HOST=office

      - name: Office wiring tests (flutter_app)
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/services/office_wiring_test.dart

      # Validates the manifest (fails loudly on any issue), builds the
      # fa web app with FA_HOST=office and assembles the site slice —
      # the artifact under test AND the upload below.
      - name: Build Office add-in
        run: bash scripts/build_office_addin.sh

      # chromium + webkit: Outlook on the web runs the taskpane in
      # whichever engine the browser has, so both must boot the pane.
      - name: Playwright e2e (chromium + webkit)
        run: |
          cd office_addin/e2e
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium webkit
          npx playwright test --reporter=line

      - name: Upload assembled add-in
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: office-addin
          path: build/pages/root/outlook/

# PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the installer generation pipeline — every
          # sh artifact under site/ and the generator that renders them.
          # Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke (pull_request
          # + validation dispatch); the classifier failure arm above runs
          # it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^site/|^scripts/gen_installers\.dart$)'; then
            echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1659: the office add-in acceptance suite — the exact path
          # list the retired standalone office-addin.yml push/PR triggers
          # carried. Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke
          # (pull_request + validation dispatch); the classifier failure
          # arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^office_addin/|^flutter_app/|^packages/|^lib/|^pubspec\.lock$|^scripts/build_office_addin\.sh$|^\.github/workflows/office-addin\.yml$)'; then
            echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
            # Dispatch done — the stages classifier below reads a
            # pull_request event's base/head only; on dispatches the group
            # outputs stay with the non-PR filter step (full gate).
            exit 0
          fi
          stages=$(scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run |
            sed -n 's/^Fast gate scope: .*stages://p')
          echo "gate stages:[$stages]"
          # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.
          [ -z "$(echo $stages)" ] && stages="size analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"
          case " $stages " in *"flutter"*) echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          case " $stages " in *"test-core"*) echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          case " $stages " in *"analyze"*) echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          # Issue #551: test/integration changes select the mock-LLM leg.
          case " $stages " in *"integration-mock"*) echo "intmock=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          # All nine stages selected = a shared/unknown path changed:
          if [ -z "$(echo $stages)" ]; then
            # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.
            stages="size analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"
          fi
          if [ "$(echo $stages | wc -w)" -eq 9 ]; then
            echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #303: the #262 DoD perf gate must red-block the MERGE for
          # trajectory regressions, not only the release — before #551 the
          # only integration leg outside PRs was tag-time. The perf-gate
          # leg re-selects the same gate via --tags perf. Paths = everything
          # the #262 fix touched: ledger core, fa_ui trajectory widgets, CLI
          # trajectory parts, the fah entrypoint, its tests, and the app's
          # session load path.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^lib/src/trajectory/|^packages/fa_ui/lib/src/trajectory/|^lib/src/cli/trajectory_|^bin/fah\.dart$|^test/(integration/)?trajectory/|^flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service(_sessions)?\.dart$)'; then
            echo "perf=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1241 REG-1: the usage fold consumes the trajectory ledger's
          # model_request_summary records and the session chain's shape —
          # a red usage-fold suite blocks the merge even when the regular
          # legs are green.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^lib/src/trajectory/|^lib/src/session/|^lib/src/usage/|^test/usage/|^lib/src/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger\.dart$)'; then
            echo "usagefold=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  # kernel's last-match-wins read/write enforcement of rw mounts under a

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.

        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible on every resolve, and the
  # breaking arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview nobody

quality-gate:
    name: Quality gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes, static, flutter-analyze, test-core, coverage-gate, guards, flutter-tests, app-crap-gate, test-faui, perf-gate, usage-fold, cli-visual-settings, cube-kernel-live, build-web, build-android, build-ios, build-macos, integration-mock, hostile-env, fa-aot-build, pty-integration-linux, pty-coverage-gate, pty-visual, supply-chain, dep-audit, installer-portability, installer-verify, install-pin-gate, flutter-app-exzone, flutter-app-lock-smoke, office-addin-suite]
    if: always() && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    # #1368: the publish job consumes dart_ok — the pure-Dart package verdict
    # — instead of this aggregate's result. The aggregate itself stays the
    # single required check: any red leg (platform included) still fails it.
    outputs:
      dart_ok: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.dart_ok }}
    steps:
      - name: Report leg results
        run: |
          echo "static        = ${{ needs.static.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "test-core     = ${{ needs.test-core.result }}"
          echo "coverage-gate = ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "guards        = ${{ needs.guards.result }}"
          echo "flutter-analyze = ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}"
          echo "flutter-tests = ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}"
          echo "test-faui     = ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}"
          echo "app-crap-gate = ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}"
          echo "perf-gate     = ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}"
          echo "usage-fold    = ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}"
          echo "cube-live     = ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}"
          echo "cli-visual    = ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}"
          echo "build-web     = ${{ needs.build-web.result }}"
          echo "build-android = ${{ needs.build-android.result }}"
          echo "build-ios     = ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}"
          echo "build-macos   = ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}"
          echo "integ-mock    = ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "pty-integ-linux = ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}"
          echo "fa-aot-build  = ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}"
          echo "pty-gates     = ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "pty-visual    = ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}"
          echo "supply-chain  = ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}"
          echo "dep-audit     = ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}"
          echo "installer-it = ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}"
          echo "installer-reg  = ${{ needs.installer-portability.result }}"
          echo "pin-gate    = ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}"
          echo "exzone      = ${{ needs.flutter-app-exzone.result }}"
          echo "lock-smoke  = ${{ needs.flutter-app-lock-smoke.result }}"
          echo "office-addin  = ${{ needs.office-addin-suite.result }}"
      - name: Fail on any real failure (skipped security = dodge = FAIL)
        id: gate
        env:
          R_CHANGES: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          R_SUPPLY_CHAIN: ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}
          R_DEP_AUDIT: ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}

          R_GUARDS: ${{ needs.guards.result }}
          R_FLUTTER: ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}
          R_CRAP: ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}
          R_FAUI: ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}
          R_PERF: ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}

          # generation, staged-version desync, cap trim) must redden the
          # PR, not surface at tag time. Rehearses the NEXT tag's payload
          # exactly like the nightly leg did (gh-1522).
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the stamp of the NEXT tag: v$next"

blocks.text:
# Runner split (gh-1005, 2026-09-30): pure-Dart AND all PTY/terminal jobs ->
# ubuntu-24.04-arm (public repo: free, SEPARATE capacity pool from the x64
# queue). Flutter-test legs on arm64 bootstrap the SDK via git clone — Flutter
# ships NO official linux-arm64 SDK (stable manifest is x64 only;
# subosito/flutter-action fails 'version: any architecture: arm64'); x64
# Flutter jobs keep the action. The self-hosted M5 pool is ONE runner
# (fa-m5-1, user LaunchAgent) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work:
# cube-kernel-live. PR PTY legs (integration shards, coverage/duration gates,
# Terminal visual) run hosted-Linux only and never wait on fa-m5-1.
name: CI

on:
  push:
    # gh-1537: NO `branches: [main]` here — the post-merge main CI run is
    # retired. The SM's pre-merge validation dispatch (machine-sm.yml ->
    # factory-sm, strictly serialized) validates the exact tree that
    # merges, so a main-push run would be pure repetition; retiring it
    # kills the duplicate wall time AND the release-bot-commit churn that
    # retriggered it (#1522 lands the tag-sourced versions). The v* tag
    # push stays: the release pipeline (publish/binaries) keys on it, and
    # the full quality gate runs on the tag BEFORE anything publishes.
    tags: ['v*']
  # Dispatch-only CI on PR heads (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes
  # fire NO CI — the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger.
  # It dispatches this workflow on the PR head when validation is due
  # (validate-fresh / validate-armed rules), so intermediate dev/rework
  # pushes and silent branch updates are free. Required checks still
  # match: the dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      releaseDryRun:
        description: 'gh-1172: run the release pipeline without the push/tag (logs the commit+tag that WOULD land)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      releaseDispatch:
        description: 'gh-1172: real release (cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release directly, gh-1522) on manual dispatch — requires refs/heads/main; bare validation dispatches stay inert'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  # Any release publication (API `gh release create`, web UI, or a pushed
  # annotated tag) builds + attaches the binaries matrix. Pushed tags also
  # arrive via the push filter above; the quality gate is NOT re-run by
  # the release twin — the release-dedupe pre-check (gh-1625) short-circuits
  # every gate leg when the tag's GREEN push run already gates it, while
  # the release-specific legs (binaries attach, release-provenance,
  # installer-smoke) keep running on the twin (the retired comment here
  # only made the binaries UPLOAD idempotent — duplicate create +
  # --clobber, last wins — while the full 35-40 min gate still re-ran,
  # doubling release wall time).
  release:
    types: [published]
  schedule:
    # Coalesced auto-release catch-up: when pushes outpace the 2h coalesce
    # window, this releases the pending commits (pub.dev caps ~12 publishes/day).
    # gh-1551: the schedule tick IS the release arming mechanism (gh-1537
    # retired the post-merge main run) — but a tick with zero commits on
    # main since the last v* tag has nothing to release, so the
    # `release-pending` pre-check job short-circuits the whole quality
    # gate in seconds (every leg shows SKIPPED explicitly, the run stays
    # green — never a silent absence, never 35-40 min for an empty tick).
    - cron: '23 */2 * * *'

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Tag/schedule
# runs are never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)

# gh-1659: [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (office-addin.yml runs standalone per PR today)

## Description

## [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (stop the per-PR standalone workflow)

### Product frame

Every PR touching `lib/**`, `packages/**`, `flutter_app/**` (most PRs) currently triggers a SECOND, standalone workflow — "Office add-in" (`office-addin.yml`, e.g. run 38965610602 on `feat/1646-antistop`). The PR page shows two CI entries per push; the check runs outside the ci.yml matrix and its name has to be tracked separately in branch protection. It should be one job inside the common `ci.yml` matrix, path-gated the same way the other jobs are.

### Evidence

- `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml` — `on: push/pull_request: branches:[main]` with paths `office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`.
- ci.yml already has the canonical pattern: a `changes` job (outputs per-path filters) + jobs gated on `needs.changes.outputs.<filter> == 'true'` (see `Core tests` at line ~789 and its `if:` at ~878).

### Required capabilities

- **C1 — job moves into ci.yml.** The `office-addin-suite` job (build + suite from `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`) becomes a ci.yml job gated on a new `changes` output (e.g. `office_addin` — same path list as today). No behavior change to what the job runs.
- **C2 — standalone PR/push triggers go away.** `office-addin.yml` keeps ONLY the `workflow_dispatch` entry (the daily-publish addin leg — `pages.yml` and the daily-publish flow depend on it; its dispatch group must stay intact). The `push`/`pull_request` blocks are deleted so a PR never spawns the separate workflow again.
- **C3 — branch protection stays coherent.** If the ruleset requires today's check name "Office add-in / office-addin-suite", either the moved job keeps a matching `name:` or the ruleset is updated to the new "CI / …" name — the owner applies ruleset changes; the PR must document the exact new check name in its description.
- **C4 — no path-skip regression.** PRs touching none of the office-addin paths must NOT run the job (same skip as today); the ci.yml always-runs pattern (line ~789 comment) must not be violated — skipped-vs-passed reporting stays correct for the ruleset.

### Test matrix

- actionlint / workflow lint in CI (existing gates).
- Manual: open/see a PR touching only `lib/**` — exactly ONE workflow (CI) runs, with the office-addin job inside; a PR touching only `docs/**` skips it.
- Dispatch the daily leg (`workflow_dispatch`) — still works from `office-addin.yml`.

### Platform inventory

- `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml` (remove push/pull_request triggers).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (changes job output + new job).
- No Dart changes.

### Security

No new secrets or permissions; the job keeps its current `contents: read`.

### Acceptance

- [ ] AC1: a `lib/**`-only PR runs the office-addin suite inside ci.yml (one workflow entry per push).
- [ ] AC2: `office-addin.yml` no longer fires on push/pull_request; the daily dispatch leg still works.
- [ ] AC3: the new check name is documented for the owner's ruleset update.
- [ ] AC4: non-touching PRs skip the job exactly as today.

# Office add-in (Outlook taskpane) acceptance suite (issues #89, #182):
# the taskpane IS the fa Flutter web app (outlook/app/) — validates the
# manifest, builds the app bundle with the office host flag, runs the
# office package Dart unit tests, the app's office wiring tests, and
# Playwright (chromium + webkit) against the assembled pane pages.
#
# gh-1659: this workflow is the DISPATCH-ONLY daily leg now. The PR/push
# gate moved into ci.yml (job `office-addin-suite`, path-gated on the
# classifier's `office_addin` output — same path list the retired
# push/pull_request triggers carried), so a PR gets ONE workflow entry
# instead of two. daily-publish.yml still dispatches THIS workflow for
# the addin leg and watches its office-addin-suite job (#343/#344), and
# the two job bodies are pinned step-identical by
# test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart — update both together.
name: Office add-in

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177) — but a
# workflow_dispatch run (the daily-publish addin leg) gets its OWN group:
# a push landing mid-daily used to cancel the leg's run, failing the leg
# as "higher priority waiting request exists" and self-filing a false
# release issue (issue #423).
concurrency:
  group: Office add-in-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && format('dispatch-{0}', github.run_id) || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# SEC-08 (#796): explicit minimal permissions (artifact uploads only).
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  office-addin-suite:
    name: Office add-in suite
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily addin watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # dart + chrome-platform tests + add-in build + Playwright
    # chromium/webkit install & e2e; historically ~20m.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 22

      # office_addin/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root),
      # so its pub get must follow the root's.
      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      - name: Dart unit tests (office_addin/dart)
        run: cd office_addin/dart && dart pub get && dart test

      # The app build needs the gitignored placeholders (.env asset and
      # firebase_options.dart) — same dance pages.yml does.
      - name: App placeholders (.env + firebase_options)
        run: |
          touch [REDACTED:Credential File]
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 2): resolve flutter_app through the
      # shared retry action BEFORE the first flutter consumer — the package
      # config doesn't exist at checkout, so "Chrome boot tests" would
      # otherwise trigger flutter test's implicit (unenforced, unretried)
      # pub get first.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The office boot seam compiles web-only code, so its guard tests run
      # on the chrome platform (VM suite can't import them). FA_HOST=office
      # compiles the real boot branch in; Office.js is absent in the test
      # browser, pinning the clean office_unavailable failure path.
      - name: Chrome boot tests (flutter_app/test/web)
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/web --platform chrome --dart-define=FA_HOST=office

      - name: Office wiring tests (flutter_app)
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/services/office_wiring_test.dart

      # Validates the manifest (fails loudly on any issue), builds the
      # fa web app with FA_HOST=office and assembles the site slice —
      # the artifact under test AND the upload below.
      - name: Build Office add-in
        run: bash scripts/build_office_addin.sh

      # chromium + webkit: Outlook on the web runs the taskpane in
      # whichever engine the browser has, so both must boot the pane.
      - name: Playwright e2e (chromium + webkit)
        run: |
          cd office_addin/e2e
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium webkit
          npx playwright test --reporter=line

      - name: Upload assembled add-in
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: office-addin

blocks.text:
# PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the installer generation pipeline — every
          # sh artifact under site/ and the generator that renders them.
          # Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke (pull_request
          # + validation dispatch); the classifier failure arm above runs
          # it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^site/|^scripts/gen_installers\.dart$)'; then
            echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1659: the office add-in acceptance suite — the exact path
          # list the retired standalone office-addin.yml push/PR triggers
          # carried. Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke
          # (pull_request + validation dispatch); the classifier failure
          # arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^office_addin/|^flutter_app/|^packages/|^lib/|^pubspec\.lock$|^scripts/build_office_addin\.sh$|^\.github/workflows/office-addin\.yml$)'; then
            echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
            # Dispatch done — the stages classifier below reads a
            # pull_request event's base/head only; on dispatches the group
            # outputs stay with the non-PR filter step (full gate).
            exit 0
          fi
          stages=$(scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run |
            sed -n 's/^Fast gate scope: .*stages://p')
          echo "gate stages:[$stages]"
          # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.
          [ -z "$(echo $stages)" ] && stages="size analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"
          case " $stages " in *"flutter"*) echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          case " $stages " in *"test-core"*) echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          case " $stages " in *"analyze"*) echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          # Issue #551: test/integration changes select the mock-LLM leg.
          case " $stages " in *"integration-mock"*) echo "intmock=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          # All nine stages selected = a shared/unknown path changed:
          if [ -z "$(echo $stages)" ]; then
            # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.
            stages="size analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"
          fi
          if [ "$(echo $stages | wc -w)" -eq 9 ]; then

quality-gate:
    name: Quality gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes, static, flutter-analyze, test-core, coverage-gate, guards, flutter-tests, app-crap-gate, test-faui, perf-gate, usage-fold, cli-visual-settings, cube-kernel-live, build-web, build-android, build-ios, build-macos, integration-mock, hostile-env, fa-aot-build, pty-integration-linux, pty-coverage-gate, pty-visual, supply-chain, dep-audit, installer-portability, installer-verify, install-pin-gate, flutter-app-exzone, flutter-app-lock-smoke, office-addin-suite]
    if: always() && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    # #1368: the publish job consumes dart_ok — the pure-Dart package verdict
    # — instead of this aggregate's result. The aggregate itself stays the
    # single required check: any red leg (platform included) still fails it.
    outputs:
      dart_ok: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.dart_ok }}
    steps:
      - name: Report leg results
        run: |
          echo "static        = ${{ needs.static.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "test-core     = ${{ needs.test-core.result }}"
          echo "coverage-gate = ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "guards        = ${{ needs.guards.result }}"
          echo "flutter-analyze = ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}"
          echo "flutter-tests = ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}"
          echo "test-faui     = ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}"
          echo "app-crap-gate = ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}"
          echo "perf-gate     = ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}"
          echo "usage-fold    = ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}"
          echo "cube-live     = ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}"
          echo "cli-visual    = ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}"
          echo "build-web     = ${{ needs.build-web.result }}"
          echo "build-android = ${{ needs.build-android.result }}"
          echo "build-ios     = ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}"
          echo "build-macos   = ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}"
          echo "integ-mock    = ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "pty-integ-linux = ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}"
          echo "fa-aot-build  = ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}"
          echo "pty-gates     = ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "pty-visual    = ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}"
          echo "supply-chain  = ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}"
          echo "dep-audit     = ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}"
          echo "installer-it = ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}"
          echo "installer-reg  = ${{ needs.installer-portability.result }}"
          echo "pin-gate    = ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}"
          echo "exzone      = ${{ needs.flutter-app-exzone.result }}"
          echo "lock-smoke  = ${{ needs.flutter-app-lock-smoke.result }}"
          echo "office-addin  = ${{ needs.office-addin-suite.result }}"
      - name: Fail on any real failure (skipped security = dodge = FAIL)
        id: gate
        env:
          R_CHANGES: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          R_SUPPLY_CHAIN: ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}
          R_DEP_AUDIT: ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}
          R_STATIC: ${{ needs.static.result }}
          R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE: ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}
          R_TEST_CORE: ${{ needs.test-core.result }}
          R_COVERAGE: ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}
          R_GUARDS: ${{ needs.guards.result }}
          R_FLUTTER: ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}
          R_CRAP: ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}
          R_FAUI: ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}
          R_PERF: ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}
          R_USAGE_FOLD: ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}
          R_CUBE: ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}
          R_CLI_VISUAL: ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}
          R_BUILD_WEB: ${{ needs.build-web.result }}
          R_BUILD_ANDROID: ${{ needs.build-android.result }}
          R_BUILD_IOS: ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}
          R_BUILD_MACOS: ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}
          R_INTEG: ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}
          R_HOSTILE: ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}
          R_PTY_LINUX: ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}
          R_FA_AOT: ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}
          R_PTY_GATES: ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}
          R_PTY_VISUAL: ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_VERIFY: ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_REG: ${{ needs.installer-portability.result }}
          R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE: ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}
          R_EXZONE: ${{ needs.flutter-app-exzone.result }}
          R_LOCK_SMOKE: ${{ needs.flutter-app-lock-smoke.result }}
          R_OFFICE_ADDIN: ${{ needs.office-addin-suite.result }}
        run: |
          fail() { echo "Quality gate FAILED: $1"; exit 1; }
          # Verdict pass collects blockers WITHOUT exiting, so dart_ok is
          # always exported explicitly ('true' or 'false', never '') —
          # publish and the Provider smoke read this output and an empty
          # value must never read as either (review thread on #1370).
          dart_blocker=""
          # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
          # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
          # through with zero gates executed.
          [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
          # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
          # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
          # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
          if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
            [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
          fi
          if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
            [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
          fi
          # #1368 — two independent verdicts over the needs legs:
          #   PACKAGE legs (everything NOT platform) → dart_blocker: they
          #     gate dart_ok AND the aggregate — analyze/test/coverage must
          #     gate the publish (review thread: the case bodies were
          #     swapped in the first cut, re-enshrining the starvation);
          #   PLATFORM/NATIVE/PTY legs (build-web/android/ios/macos,
          #     fa-aot-build, installer-verify, install-pin-gate,
          #     cube-kernel-live, cli-visual-settings, pty-*) → platform_red
          #     only: they redden the required aggregate but NEVER dart_ok —
          #     a red Windows build must not hold the pure-Dart publish
          #     hostage (the v1.0.519-521 starvation).
          platform_red=false
          for kv in "static:$R_STATIC" "flutter-analyze:$R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE" "test-core:$R_TEST_CORE" "coverage-gate:$R_COVERAGE" \
                    "guards:$R_GUARDS" "flutter-tests:$R_FLUTTER" "app-crap-gate:$R_CRAP" \
                    "test-faui:$R_FAUI" "perf-gate:$R_PERF" "usage-fold:$R_USAGE_FOLD" "cube-kernel-live:$R_CUBE" \
                    "cli-visual-settings:$R_CLI_VISUAL" "build-web:$R_BUILD_WEB" \
                    "build-android:$R_BUILD_ANDROID" "build-ios:$R_BUILD_IOS" "build-macos:$R_BUILD_MACOS" \
                    "integration-mock:$R_INTEG" "hostile-env:$R_HOSTILE" \
                    "fa-aot-build:$R_FA_AOT" \
                    "pty-integration-linux:$R_PTY_LINUX" "pty-coverage-gate:$R_PTY_GATES" "pty-visual:$R_PTY_VISUAL" \
                    "installer-portability:$R_INSTALLER_REG" \
                    "installer-verify:$R_INSTALLER_VERIFY" "install-pin-gate:$R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE" \
                    "flutter-app-exzone:$R_EXZONE" "flutter-app-lock-smoke:$R_LOCK_SMOKE" "office-addin-suite:$R_OFFICE_ADDIN"; do
            name="${kv%%:*}"; r="${kv#*:}"

# --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          # Against the STAGED tree, not the repo root (#597 AC1): the
          # publish job publishes from the stage — the v0.1.407 class of
          # failure (staged resolution re-pinning vendor/dart_tui through
          # pubspec_overrides.yaml) must redden the PR, not the tag.
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/pr-dry-run-stage
          # gh-1538: the STAMP rehearsal moved here from the retired nightly
          # full-quality leg — the pre-merge gate is the single test gate
          # now, so a stamp failure (placeholder leak, changelog-section
          # generation, staged-version desync, cap trim) must redden the
          # PR, not surface at tag time. Rehearses the NEXT tag's payload
          # exactly like the nightly leg did (gh-1522).
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the stamp of the NEXT tag: v$next"

blocks.text:
# Runner split (gh-1005, 2026-09-30): pure-Dart AND all PTY/terminal jobs ->
# ubuntu-24.04-arm (public repo: free, SEPARATE capacity pool from the x64
# queue). Flutter-test legs on arm64 bootstrap the SDK via git clone — Flutter
# ships NO official linux-arm64 SDK (stable manifest is x64 only;
# subosito/flutter-action fails 'version: any architecture: arm64'); x64
# Flutter jobs keep the action. The self-hosted M5 pool is ONE runner
# (fa-m5-1, user LaunchAgent) reserved for genuinely macOS-only work:
# cube-kernel-live. PR PTY legs (integration shards, coverage/duration gates,
# Terminal visual) run hosted-Linux only and never wait on fa-m5-1.
name: CI

on:
  push:
    # gh-1537: NO `branches: [main]` here — the post-merge main CI run is
    # retired. The SM's pre-merge validation dispatch (machine-sm.yml ->
    # factory-sm, strictly serialized) validates the exact tree that
    # merges, so a main-push run would be pure repetition; retiring it
    # kills the duplicate wall time AND the release-bot-commit churn that
    # retriggered it (#1522 lands the tag-sourced versions). The v* tag
    # push stays: the release pipeline (publish/binaries) keys on it, and
    # the full quality gate runs on the tag BEFORE anything publishes.
    tags: ['v*']
  # Dispatch-only CI on PR heads (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes
  # fire NO CI — the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger.
  # It dispatches this workflow on the PR head when validation is due
  # (validate-fresh / validate-armed rules), so intermediate dev/rework
  # pushes and silent branch updates are free. Required checks still
  # match: the dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      releaseDryRun:
        description: 'gh-1172: run the release pipeline without the push/tag (logs the commit+tag that WOULD land)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      releaseDispatch:
        description: 'gh-1172: real release (cuts the annotated tag + GitHub Release directly, gh-1522) on manual dispatch — requires refs/heads/main; bare validation dispatches stay inert'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  # Any release publication (API `gh release create`, web UI, or a pushed
  # annotated tag) builds + attaches the binaries matrix. Pushed tags also
  # arrive via the push filter above; the quality gate is NOT re-run by
  # the release twin — the release-dedupe pre-check (gh-1625) short-circuits
  # every gate leg when the tag's GREEN push run already gates it, while
  # the release-specific legs (binaries attach, release-provenance,
  # installer-smoke) keep running on the twin (the retired comment here
  # only made the binaries UPLOAD idempotent — duplicate create +
  # --clobber, last wins — while the full 35-40 min gate still re-ran,
  # doubling release wall time).
  release:
    types: [published]
  schedule:
    # Coalesced auto-release catch-up: when pushes outpace the 2h coalesce
    # window, this releases the pending commits (pub.dev caps ~12 publishes/day).
    # gh-1551: the schedule tick IS the release arming mechanism (gh-1537
    # retired the post-merge main run) — but a tick with zero commits on
    # main since the last v* tag has nothing to release, so the
    # `release-pending` pre-check job short-circuits the whole quality
    # gate in seconds (every leg shows SKIPPED explicitly, the run stays
    # green — never a silent absence, never 35-40 min for an empty tick).
    - cron: '23 */2 * * *'

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Tag/schedule
# runs are never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)

    "description": "## [GOAL] Fold the Office add-in check into the shared CI matrix (stop the per-PR standalone workflow)

### Product frame

Every PR touching `lib/**`, `packages/**`, `flutter_app/**` (most PRs) currently triggers a SECOND, standalone workflow — "Office add-in" (`office-addin.yml`, e.g. run 38965610602 on `feat/1646-antistop`). The PR page shows two CI entries per push; the check runs outside the ci.yml matrix and its name has to be tracked separately in branch protection. It should be one job inside the common `ci.yml` matrix, path-gated the same way the other jobs are.

### Evidence

- `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml` — `on: push/pull_request: branches:[main]` with paths `office_addin/**`, `flutter_app/**`, `packages/**`, `lib/**`, `pubspec.lock`, `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`, `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml`.
- ci.yml already has the canonical pattern: a `changes` job (outputs per-path filters) + jobs gated on `needs.changes.outputs.<filter> == 'true'` (see `Core tests` at line ~789 and its `if:` at ~878).

### Required capabilities

- **C1 — job moves into ci.yml.** The `office-addin-suite` job (build + suite from `scripts/build_office_addin.sh`) becomes a ci.yml job gated on a new `changes` output (e.g. `office_addin` — same path list as today). No behavior change to what the job runs.
- **C2 — standalone PR/push triggers go away.** `office-addin.yml` keeps ONLY the `workflow_dispatch` entry (the daily-publish addin leg — `pages.yml` and the daily-publish flow depend on it; its dispatch group must stay intact). The `push`/`pull_request` blocks are deleted so a PR never spawns the separate workflow again.
- **C3 — branch protection stays coherent.** If the ruleset requires today's check name "Office add-in / office-addin-suite", either the moved job keeps a matching `name:` or the ruleset is updated to the new "CI / …" name — the owner applies ruleset changes; the PR must document the exact new check name in its description.
- **C4 — no path-skip regression.** PRs touching none of the office-addin paths must NOT run the job (same skip as today); the ci.yml always-runs pattern (line ~789 comment) must not be violated — skipped-vs-passed reporting stays correct for the ruleset.

### Test matrix

- actionlint / workflow lint in CI (existing gates).
- Manual: open/see a PR touching only `lib/**` — exactly ONE workflow (CI) runs, with the office-addin job inside; a PR touching only `docs/**` skips it.

- `.github/workflows/office-addin.yml` (remove push/pull_request triggers).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (changes job output + new job).
- No Dart changes.

### Security

No new secrets or permissions; the job keeps its current `contents: read`.

### Acceptance
